title: External SSH Password Authentication
detection_logic: Alert on any SSH authentication event (success or failure) using password method from any IP outside the 10.0.0.0/8 internal range.

title: External SSH Successful Password Login
detection_logic: Alert when an SSH session is accepted via password authentication from any IP not in the 10.0.1.0/24 administrative subnet.

title: SSH Brute Force High-Volume Threshold
detection_logic: Alert when a single source IP generates more than 400 'Failed password' log entries in auth.log across the entire monitoring period.

title: HTTP POST to Upload Directory
detection_logic: Alert on any HTTP POST request to paths matching /uploads/.* in the Apache access log.

title: Access to Hidden PHP File
detection_logic: Alert on any HTTP request to a PHP file whose filename begins with a dot character (hidden file convention).

title: DNS Query to Analytics-Related Domain
detection_logic: Alert on any DNS query where the queried domain name contains the substring 'analytics' to detect C2 communication disguised as analytics traffic.

title: DNS TXT Record Tunneling
detection_logic: Alert on DNS queries with record type TXT directed at non-standard or non-well-known domains, as a common indicator of DNS tunneling for data exfiltration.

title: Sensitive File Access via Audit Trail
detection_logic: Alert when the application audit log records a FILE_READ action targeting /etc/shadow, indicating credential harvesting.
